n: Event <What the Firelight Casts> is now open

missions: Clear event stages 15 times, not including tutorial stages.
Clear event stages 45 times, not including tutorial stages.
Clear event stages 85 times, not including tutorial stages.

list: A solid wooden shelf of simple workmanship, on which jams made from seasonal fruits are placed. There seems to be far too much jam here, but it doesn't matter because plenty of friends always come to visit.
A small cart converted from a wooden box, used specifically to carry bales of hay. Be careful with the pitchfork– though it's no longer sharp, it still can serve as a weapon in a pinch.

A large, frequently-used oven with many functionalities. It is said to be able to bake enough for ten people at a time. And the meat it roasts delicious enough for each to eat ten people's worth of food.
A simple, spacious, and durable storage box woven from straw. The sweet and aromatic pumpkin sitting on it is resistant to the passage of time, but less so to hungry visitors.

This translucent green gauze curtain with a lily pattern on it is deeply loved by the room's owner. The light passing through it becomes soft and tranquil, making the place resemble a warm and peaceful dream.
A partition wall made from natural stone with a rustic vibe. The room's owner thought about moving it, but nobody could accomplish the feat.
A floor lamp made from an entire dead tree trunk, the cube bulb inside burning bright, but not hot. Let the withered and decaying burn away and become a light to illuminate the future.

A panoramic display showing the beauty of the Victorian countryside during the autumnal harvest season. Many visitors hailing from farming families are unable to sit still when they see such a bountiful harvest unfolding in front of them.
A richly-colored cork floor with natural tones that perfectly capture the countryside style. Dry reeds will float across its surface from time to time, and cleaning up can be quite difficult.
'Actually, sometimes I want to be a villain, but I just can't pull it off.'
theme: A small country cabin decorated in Reed's ideal imagery of home, filled with the fragrance of honey, liqueur, and rich soup.

list:
You saw a flame burn peacefully.
Whether the path up ahead is treacherous or smooth, everything is now crystal clear.
During the 'What the Firelight Casts' event, obtain Operator Puzzle.

You have drawn the attention of an intelligence agent.
He is calm and collected in his observations. Only mere moments later, an endless stream of threads and connections have already been pieced together in his mind.
During the 'What the Firelight Casts' event, consume 2400 'Manuscripts of Ballads' in [River Valley Caravan].

The folksong manuscripts you transcribed follow the caravan's footsteps and are being carried further afield.
You truly believe that one day, they will be brought to more vibrant, thriving lands, where they will again be sung loud and clear.
Complete all stages in [Swamp In The Mists] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials and story stages).

You set foot into ruins that have long been forgotten.
The winds howled through the eroded caves, producing a terrifying roar that, to your ears, are like an elegy sung by throats weathered by history.
Clear FC-6 with a 3-star rating without any ignited Reeds

You went through a night that was shrouded in dense, thick smoke.
As you lift your head up, you see a flame scorching the dark night sky and leaving behind but the blood-colored scar we call 'dawn.'
Clear FC-8 with a 3-star rating with operators deployed in Mire no more than 3 times.

Your emotions stirred upon hearing her voice.
You find it hard to distinguish whether those words that touched you heart carried hope or ambition.
Complete all the content in [Search Warrant From the City Council] and collect the rewards.

After much pondering, you decided to present the truth.
What lies in the boundary between truth and falsehood is not an impassable chasm, but rather a tiny idea.
Complete all stages in [Ashes of Memories] on Challenge Mode.

You swept away the shadows that shrouded memories.
She is no longer someone else's shadow.
Clear FC-EX-7 with a 3-star rating with operators deployed in Mire no more than 3 times.

You carefully followed her and avoided the fatal quagmires.
A slanting beam of sunlight falls upon the murky, frigid mire, igniting a spark of hope in you.
Clear FC-EX-8 with a 3-star rating with at least 3 unignited Reeds.

After the inferno, you found a patch of land where life yet blooms.
The bitter fruits sown anew have experienced war and exile, yet they remain prepared to break through the soil to see tomorrow's daylight.
set: What the Firelight Casts Engraved Medal Set

An engraved medal set that recounts Reed's journey as she led the Taran refugees' escape.
How tight of a grasp must our past lives have for a group of people to drift within their own homeland?
Though surrounded by home on all sides, there is no way to return.
